about_the_game:
The casual idle fish-raising game Cyber Fish King can dock at the bottom of your screen, bringing calm and joy while you study or work. Unlock different species by purchasing blind boxes; whether you sell high-level fish for profit or keep them in the tank to generate income over time, you will steadily expand your aquatic kingdom.

Features:

-Blind-box collection: Unlock fish from common to rare, with clear compendium progress

-Easy growth: Mouse interactions speed up leveling, or let them grow fully idle

-Steady income: Sell high-level fish for profit, or keep them to produce continuous income

-Rich goals: Collect 100+ species, reach milestones, and become the true “Cyber Fish King”

-Soothing feel: Gentle audio and visuals help you stay focused and relaxed

Multitasking:

Cyber Fish King can comfortably sit at the bottom of the screen so you can look after your fish while getting other work done. Remember, once you have Cyber Fish King, your study and work efficiency will increase 100x!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core or AMD
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any graphics card
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core or AMD
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Good graphics card
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Good audio card

short_description: Cyber Fish King is a relaxing, stress-free idle game. A compact game that sits at the bottom of your screen so you can take a quick breather while handling other tasks! Raise digital fish and enjoy a cyber life!
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, German, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America, Korean
